process_isolation: Each model is measured in a fresh Python process.
selection: first 500 entries of the frozen ordered WSODD test manifest
timing_scope: synchronized wall-clock time from decoded BGR image to Results object; includes preprocessing, host-to-device transfer, forward pass, and postprocessing; excludes file reading and image decoding
memory_scope: peak torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated for warmed model plus one-image prediction, in MiB
flops_scope: Ultralytics get_flops estimate for the unfused trained architecture at 960; multiply-add counted as two operations
